Studies of existing forest show the same protection: in Orissa, India, villages with wider mangroves had fewer deaths in the 1999 super cyclone [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_dasvincent09_1, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_dasvincent09_2]; in Bhitarkanika the sheltered village had lower losses per household, less house damage and a higher cyclone-year paddy yield than the unprotected village [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_badola05_1, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_badola05_2, ev_crop_yield_badola05_6]; and in Bangladesh, households sheltered by the Sundarbans recalled almost half the total loss of unsheltered households after cyclone Sidr [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_akber18_1], while a separate survey found mean Sidr damage of US$1,327 per household behind the forest against US$1,478 elsewhere [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_mahbar16_1]. justification.mechanism: Mangroves give strong shelter from cyclone wind, waves and surge to what lies behind them. Planted mangroves in Hainan, China, cut mean wind speed behind the stand by 59.4% during typhoons [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_mcivor12_1], and in northern Viet Nam planting is credited with keeping a sea dyke undamaged in a 2005 typhoon and cutting the share of shrimp-farm value destroyed from 90 to 25 per cent [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ifrc11_1, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ifrc11_2]. Studies of existing forest show the same protection: in Orissa, India, villages with wider mangroves had fewer deaths in the 1999 super cyclone [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_dasvincent09_1, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_dasvincent09_2]; in Bhitarkanika the sheltered village had lower losses per household, less house damage and a higher cyclone-year paddy yield than the unprotected village [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_badola05_1, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_badola05_2, ev_crop_yield_badola05_6]; and in Bangladesh, households sheltered by the Sundarbans recalled almost half the total loss of unsheltered households after cyclone Sidr [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_akber18_1], while a separate survey found mean Sidr damage of US$1,327 per household behind the forest against US$1,478 elsewhere [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_mahbar16_1]. In Central America, wider mangrove belts meant smaller losses of economic activity after hurricanes [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_delvalle20_1, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_hochard19_1]. After community mangrove planting in Gujarat, India, 74 of 227 households surveyed reported reduced cyclone and storm damage [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_becklange16_1].
justification.conditionality: Most of this evidence measures what keeping existing mangrove forest protects, not what planting achieves; the planted-stand results from Viet Nam are uncontrolled before-and-after reports by evaluators of the implementing programme [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ifrc11_1]. Some measured results show no benefit or the reverse, and these lower the rating: in Orissa no mangrove effect on fully collapsed houses was seen near the coast [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_das11_2], protection was smaller for larger surges [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_dasvincent09_3], Bhitarkanika livestock losses were higher in the mangrove village [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_badola05_4], and in the Sundarbans tree damage and livestock losses were about the same with or without the forest [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_akber18_3, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_akber18_4]. In the newer Sundarbans survey households behind the forest also spent more on protecting themselves and fewer lived inside an embankment, so the damage gap is not all due to the mangroves [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_mahbar16_1]. A World Bank evaluation in the Mekong Delta found farming protected where planting succeeded but the coastline moving inland where seedlings failed [ev_frmg_vnppar_8]. mitigation_mechanism: Strong cyclones can cause moderate damage to mangroves. Reviews report tree damage rising quickly once winds exceed 130 km/h [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_gijsman21_1, ev_establishment_survival_mcivor12_1], and in Florida the 2005 Hurricane Wilma was estimated to have destroyed 1250 ha of mangroves [ev_asset_wind_cyclone_marois15_1]. In the Philippines, after Category 5 Typhoon Odette, 85.71% of trees in planted stands were damaged against 77.14% in natural stands [ev_climate_shock_baring24_1]; Rhizophora stylosa had the most deaths there, 14 of them in planted plots [ev_climate_shock_baring24_2], and a review reports that Rhizophora trees are more likely to die in strong winds because they cannot hold themselves up [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_gijsman21_2]. In Vietnam's Bac Lieu province storms washed out newly planted seedlings before their roots took hold [ev_frmg_vnppar_6, ev_frmg_vnppar_7], and in Bangladesh project staff report cyclones causing severe damage to planted mangroves [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ahammad13_4]. Authors of a Bangladesh study warn that cyclones can destroy mangroves directly or through raised salinity and lack of oxygen, and that this must be weighed when investing in large replanting programmes [ev_climate_shock_dasgupta19_2]. On St Croix, hurricanes the year after a 1978 restoration planting caused some wash-out and were partly to blame for losses: 40% of 86,000 planted seedlings survived but only 1–2% of the sown propagules [ev_climate_shock_krauss23_1]. After Typhoon Haiyan in the Philippines, mangroves older than 32 years had 95% mortality with no recovery, while those younger than 8 years fully recovered within 2 years [ev_climate_shock_asbridge18_3]. In Florida and Honduras, hurricane wind and surge killed existing mangrove trees, and the forest floor then sank as the dead roots rotted, so the damage went on after the storm [ev_climate_shock_cah06_1].
caveats: Practitioners rate mangrove regeneration in Senegal as coping well with local windstorms and planting in Bangladesh as coping moderately with tropical storms [ev_asset_wind_cyclone_wocat_1442_2011_local_windstorm, ev_asset_wind_cyclone_wocat_4300_2019_tropical_storm]. The review figures describe existing forest [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_gijsman21_1, ev_asset_wind_cyclone_marois15_1]; the Philippine comparison covers a single bay with few plots after a single extreme storm [ev_climate_shock_baring24_1]; the Vietnam and Bangladesh accounts come from evaluators and project staff, not measurements [ev_frmg_vnppar_6, ev_frmg_vnppar_7, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ahammad13_4]; and the Bangladesh warning is the authors' general advice [ev_climate_shock_dasgupta19_2]. Planted stands are most at risk before their roots take hold, so the threat to an investment sits in the establishment years. In Japan, a strong typhoon caused no damage to six young planted mangroves, but the authors say this was partly luck: the peak waves came at low tide in a sheltered bay [ev_climate_shock_takagi23_1]. The St Croix and Haiyan results are cited second-hand, and the Haiyan source does not say whether the old and young stands were planted [ev_climate_shock_krauss23_1, ev_climate_shock_asbridge18_3]. The Florida and Honduras finding and the Rhizophora review describe existing forest, and the review cites other studies [ev_climate_shock_cah06_1, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_gijsman21_2].
